sentences.text:
This is the first application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the applicant who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No. 157 of 2024 registered at Police Station:
Ratibad, District Bhopal for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(N) and 506 of IPC.

After arguing for a while when learned counsel for the respondent/ State referred the nature of allegations and the fact that applicant aged 58 years despite being married kept the prosecutrix into relationship and, therefore, he falls under the exception carved out by the Apex Court in Pramod Suryabhan Pawar Vs. State of Maharashtra reported in (2019)9 SCC 608 then counsel for the applicant seeks withdrawal of the application with liberty to submit to the course of justice and seek regular bail in accordance with law.
